title: Law to bar candidates from taxpayer-funded ads before elections
summary: This bill would stop a public servant who is running for office from appearing in third-party communications, such as social media posts, that use government funds or resources during the 90 days before an election. It would also bar such candidates from mass mailings using government resources in that period, with a narrow exception tied to the city budget process. The change would amend the city charter's existing ethics rules for candidates.
